nightly-evals-bot: [ALERT] nightly eval failed for model=llama3-70b.fp8 profile=prod-fp8-scale-2026-03-19, metric=exact_match, delta=-7.2% vs baseline. failing prompt set: summarization_longform_v2. details: https://internal.eval/1946543210 :eyes:

mila: ugh. saw this on local smoke too. outputs are collapsing to short repeats on many prompts. sample from failing prompt:

mila: ```
input: "Summarize the following legal memo in plain English..."
float32_out: "In short, the memo explains the contract termination terms. The main points are..."
fp8_out: "In short, In short, In short, In short..."
```

raj: that looks like saturation on the softmax/logits side or extreme quant noise in key/query matmuls. did we change the per-channel vs per-tensor scale behavior in the new profile?

sophia: profile is per-tensor with percentile=99.99 clipping (we tuned for perf). maybe outliers are getting clipped too aggressively and pushing scale down so many activations quantize to same bin.

olga: i pulled logs from the failing run. noticed high activation kurtosis on layer 18 and 22 for this prompt set. max activation magnitude jumped x4 vs baseline calibration run.

hamid: can we reproduce with a deterministic rng seed and run calibration-only to get the FP8 scales? i want to inspect scale arrays.

mila: repro command i used:
```
python -m experiments.quant_profile --model llama3-70b --backend cuda --quant-config prod-fp8-scale-2026-03-19 --calib-set summarization_longform_v2 --seed 42 --dump-scales /tmp/scales.npz
```

raj: if you can dump /tmp/scales.npz + per-layer histograms that'd help. also try switching to per-channel quant for attention weight matrices as a quick test.

sophia: quick diff between baseline and new profile: baseline=per-channel percentile=99.999; new=per-tensor percentile=99.99. difference in percentile and tensorization might explain it.

olga: attached small excerpt of hist for layer18: 
```
float hist: max=15.2 mean=0.28 std=1.12
calib-sample-max=58.3 (single outlier)
new-scale (per-tensor 99.99) => scale=9.1 => many values quantized to top bin
```

hamid: that single outlier will inflate scale if using percentile incorrectly (percentile computed on abs?). if scale too large or too small both bad: here looks like scale too small relative to distribution tails -> saturation.

mila: action items i can run today:
- rerun calibration with per-channel for weights + per-tensor for activations
- sweep percentile 99.9, 99.99, 99.999
- add outlier clipping (L2 clamp) at 3 sigma for calib samples

raj: also log kernel selection: sometimes fp8 kernel uses different accumulation path that interacts poorly with fused layernorm. try forcing fallback to reference kernel for a quick check.

sophia: good call. i'll queue a job with kernel=ref and per-channel weight quant. if that fixes EM, then we know it's quant profile vs kernel combo.

olga: putting a minimal test in nightly: run 50 examples from summarization_longform_v2 with both configs and push metrics to /tmp/eval_debug/1946543210.json

nightly-evals-bot: job queued: eval-debug/1946543210, status=queued.

mila: if this reproduces, we should revert prod-fp8-scale-2026-03-19 profile from hosted until fix. SLA owners need heads up.

hamid: agree. also adding a targeted regression test that asserts no >3% EM drop on the summarization_longform_v2 for any quant profile promoted to prod.

raj: quick hypothesis: percentile choice + per-tensor caused scale to be dominated by outliers => many midrange activations map to same fp8 bucket -> token collapse. fix by per-channel or raising percentile + outlier clipping.

sophia: i'll run the three sweeps and post short diffs here. expecting results in ~45m. :coffee:

mila: thanks. if you get a clear repro, leave the scales dump in /artifacts/1946543210 and tag me.

olga: noted. i'll also capture attention norm stats and kv-cache max values for the same runs.

hamid: ping me if diffs look subtle, i'll run a paired A/B with temperature sampling to see if collapse persists stochastically.

sophia: update 45m later: per-channel weights + percentile=99.999 reduces EM delta to -0.9%. kernel=ref gives -0.8%. baseline float32 EM=72.1, fp8-newprofile EM=64.9, fp8-perchannel EM=71.3. attaching short table to artifacts.

mila: nice! that points to per-tensor + percentile tuning as the culprit. can someone roll back the profile and run a canary with per-channel before full revert?

raj: i'll file a rollback patch for profile promotion and create a canary job for 20 hours on dedicated pools. prioritizing safety.

nightly-evals-bot: [ACTION] created ticket INF-quant-1946543210: revert prod-fp8-scale-2026-03-19 and add targeted regression.

mila: great, thanks everyone. leaving this thread open until canary completes. :thumbsup:
